title: Red Heron Exploits Critical Gitea Flaw to Steal Repositories and Deploy Linux Rootkit
content_md: A threat actor tracked as Red Heron has exploited the critical Gitea remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2026-60004 to steal source-code repositories, establish persistent access, and deploy a covert Linux toolset consisting of the JITTERLY implant and SIXZUT LD_PRELOAD rootkit. Acronis reported that the actor rapidly weaponized the flaw against internet-exposed Gitea environments, turning initial access […] The post Red Heron Exploits Critical Gitea Flaw to Steal Repositories and Deploy Linux Rootkit appeared first on GBHackers Security | #1 Globally Trusted Cyber Security News Platform .

CVE-2026-60004.evidence: Acronis reported the Red Heron actor rapidly weaponized CVE-2026-60004 against internet-exposed Gitea servers, stealing repositories and deploying the JITTERLY implant plus the SIXZUT LD_PRELOAD rootkit for persistence.
